title: Chapter 227: Public Battlefield In The Southern Theater
content:
Chapter 227: Public Battlefield In The Southern Theater

In the past few days, whenever Wu Qing had free time, he possessed a four-star insect man and went to the wilderness area outside the Zerg underground world territory, exploring quickly in different directions.

Every time he encountered a pack of underground dire wolves, Wu Qing tracked the whereabouts of the underground dire wolves several times and found that these wandering underground dire wolves were basically hunting.

Hunting in the wilderness area of the underground world is very difficult. The creatures that can survive in the wilderness area of the underground world have their own unique way of survival. To find them and kill them, not only strength but also skills are required.

Wu Qing discovered that these underground dire wolves are the hunting masters of the wilderness area of the underground world. Those underground dire wolves that are not strong always have a way to find prey hidden deep and use the power of the group to hunt.

The underground dire wolves that hunt enough prey will take the prey on a long journey and return to the deeper part of the wilderness. Wu Qing tracked for a long time but did not follow the destination.

Wu Qing guessed that direction should be the territory of the underground dire wolf tribe. The distance was very far. Wu Qing did not go deeper as he encountered more and more underground dire wolf packs along the way.

The main focus of the Zerg now should be on the main battlefield of the camp war that they are about to go to. There is no need to open another battlefield in the underground world at such a long distance for the time being.

Judging from the character of the underground dire wolf pack, it is also unrealistic to lead them to the Zerg territory to fight.

The opening of the Zerg underground world battlefield can only be put on hold until the Zerg is strong enough to send troops to wipe out the surrounding enemies in one fell swoop.

Of course, the Zerg is not doing nothing in the underground world. Wu Qing will send more Zerg puppies into the wilderness area to collect information, fight various creatures, and fight underground dire wolves.

It is still possible to fight the underground dire wolf pack with only Zerg puppies. The Zerg has occupied more underground world territories, and the supply of energy resources will become more and more sufficient, and the number of Zerg puppies can be increased as much as possible.

25 energy per Zerg puppy, it doesn't matter how much it consumes, as long as it can kill an underground dire wolf, it can earn back the energy cost, and the small amount of gas resources obtained are pure profit, this kind of deal is very cost-effective.

As long as they keep persisting, the Zerg may find other opportunities in the process of exploring the underground world.

...

Mengzhong City.

Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has a stronger sense of urgency since he saw the Zerg send 500,000 Zerg destroyers to the Naga tribe.

He immediately reported the situation to the tribe, explained the interests, and applied for support from the tribe to speed up the construction of the space transmission channel.

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present, Wild Fruit Reading, install the latest version.

The construction of the space transmission channel is not simple, it requires specific talents and special materials, and the mobilization of these things is relatively difficult.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce has achieved the current construction progress by borrowing the space transmission channel of the Naga tribe to transmit personnel and materials, but Gong Zhe feels that it is still too slow.

Gong Zhe discovered through continuous intelligence collection that the Zerg did have the strength to approach that of the big tribes. If the Goblins neglected the Zerg, the Zerg would definitely find other ways to enter the outside world.

The Zerg is now sending troops to the Naga battlefield, and next to it is the Southern Free Land, which has strong overall strength. If things go wrong, the Zerg may find another way.

The Zerg has the protection of the powerful and strong strength, and is not afraid of the threat of the Goblins. Now the Goblins need the Zerg.

The Zerg energy coins that the Goblins urgently need are also of great use in other big tribes and forces. As long as the Zerg leak a little news, someone will take the initiative to deliver benefits.

Gong Zhe is worried that if the relationship between the two tribes does not continue to get closer, it will be difficult to predict how things will develop in the future.

Gong Zhe now introduces the progress of the construction of the space transmission channel to the Zerg representatives in Mengzhong City every day, and introduces some of the main battlefields of the camp war that the Zerg will soon go to.

Gong Zhe didn't know this information before. Although the goblins valued the Zerg energy coins, they still looked down on the Zerg in their hearts, thinking that sending the Zerg to a stage to show their strength would be a great help and enough to get the Zerg's reward.

As for some details, the goblin leaders didn't consider them at all. Although the people below knew it, they didn't dare to make decisions on their own. Adhering to the principle of less trouble is worse than more trouble, no one mentioned it.

This led to Wu Qing knowing that the goblins wanted to send the Zerg to the main battlefield of the camp war, but he didn't know where to send it and what the situation was like there.

These important details were clearly seen by Gong Zhe, but he didn't dare to ask for these details at will because of his low status before. Now he felt that the situation was special, so he mustered up the courage to ask for these requests.

The people above didn't make it difficult for him and provided him with some information, which allowed him to take the opportunity to meet with the Zerg host representatives and provide some important intelligence to the Zerg bit by bit.

Wu Qing also got some information about the main battlefield of the camp war that he was going to.

In summary, it is a public battlefield where all races can demonstrate their strength under the leadership of the major races in the local camp.

Corresponding to this is the racial battlefield where the Naga tribe is responsible, where the whole tribe undertakes all combat tasks.

Many powerful races want to demonstrate their strength and improve their status, so they will send important figures to lead strong troops to fight in the public battlefield.

Only in the public battlefield can everyone see your strength with their own eyes. Otherwise, if you fight with the evil god camp alone in a remote place, no one else will know.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

The process for the races in the local camp to become a big clan is very difficult and the conditions are very harsh.

The big clan has many privileges in the local camp. Only when they become a big clan can they truly have the right to speak in the local camp.

Under the big clan, they are all ordinary races. Even if you are much stronger than other races, your actual status is not much different. If you want to be responsible for others, you have to be careful that others will complain to the big clan.

If you ruin your reputation in the local camp, it is easy for the big clan to play tricks on you. As long as you are targeted, many things will be very difficult to deal with.

Therefore, the public battlefield of the local camp is a very important place. It is a platform for all the progressive races to strive for progress.

The public battlefield that the Zerg is about to go to is the largest public battlefield in the Southern Theater, and its name is the Southern Theater Public Battlefield.

The Goblin tribe is one of the most powerful tribes that dominate the public battlefield in the southern theater, and has a high voice, so it can easily send the Zerg over.

There are thousands of races fighting in the public battlefield of the southern theater, coming and going, and there are a lot of them. Some races that have established a foothold there can apply for a defense zone as a territory and develop directly in the theater.

In this world, fighting is not only consumption, but also has huge benefits. Races that avoid fighting are equivalent to giving up the shortcut to rapid development.

Powerful races all rely on constant fighting to grow and develop. The fastest way to obtain luck is to go to the battlefield to grab it. If you want to develop peacefully, you have been left behind by others for eighteen streets, and you can't become a big or strong tribe.

Of course, whether you grab luck from the battlefield or send luck, this is the time to show your ability.

It is also not okay to rush to the battlefield.

The enemies faced in the public battlefield of the southern theater are many alien races that the evil god camp fights in turn.

Affected by the participation of various races in the war on the local side, the evil god camp had to let many foreign races take turns to fight and break the advantages of the local camp's arms.

In this way, after a long period of development, the current public battlefield in the southern theater was formed.

From the overall situation, the evil god camp now occupies an advantageous position. There are often powerful foreign races coming to fight, which makes the local races defeated. The elite troops of the major races need to go to the battlefield in person to stabilize the situation.

Because of this, this battlefield is also a touchstone for the strength of various races in the local camp. Whether it is strong or not depends on the performance on the battlefield. Under the watchful eyes of the public, it cannot be faked.

There are many large tribes in the local camp who have walked out of this battlefield. Each of them is a powerful existence that has dominated this battlefield for an era.

They beat the alien tribes in the evil god camp completely without temper, thus gaining the recognition of the major tribes, and finally after a systematic effort, they finally gained the status of a large tribe.

These large tribes are role models for the Zerg, and the Zerg's short-term goal is the status of a large tribe in the local camp.

Of course, in this process, the strength of the Zerg must be truly improved to a level that matches the status of the big clans. This is not a simple process.

With a goal, the development of the Zerg has a direction.

The Goblin clan provided Wu Qing with this information to paint a big picture for Wu Qing, showing the status of the Goblin clan in the local camp, so that the Zerg clan will not see the situation clearly and turn to others.

In this world, Wu Qing does not mix any personal feelings. As long as it is profitable, he will cooperate with anyone.

The Goblin clan is a good partner. As long as the Goblin clan does not go too far, the Zerg clan will not change partners at will. The reputation of the Zerg clan is equally important.

The Zerg energy coin is very suitable for the Goblin clan. For a race like the Goblin clan that is as technological as a civilization, energy is the most core thing for them.

The Goblin clan is the one that values high-purity energy coins the most in this world.

As long as the two clans maintain a good cooperative relationship, Wu Qing is ready to use the Zerg energy coin to push the status of the Goblin clan in the local camp forward.

In the early stage of the development of the Zerg, it is easier to get things done with someone above you. Even in the later stage, when the human race under Wu Qing is born and technological civilization comes to this world, many things of the goblins can be used for reference.

From Wu Qing's perspective, the goblins are one of the best partners.

The goblins did not provide more details about the public battlefield in the southern theater, but with the information provided now, Wu Qing's goal is very clear and the preparations have been made more fully.
